verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a stability metric, defined as the proportion of user application sessions that are error free, with configurable stability targets. It also documents release-scoped views: filtering the dashboard by release (including a "does not equal" operator), identifying which release introduced errors, and release annotations on the error-rate timeline. That covers crash-free sessions and lets an SRE look at one release at a time, but the evidence does not show crash-free users, per-release adoption, or a dedicated canary-vs-stable comparison. Missing for 10: crash-free users metric, release adoption tracking, explicit side-by-side release comparison, independent or hands-on corroboration.
